fighters.name: Yelka Bellpull
fighters.look: Lean woman in her 40s. Severe side-shaved crop, a broad weather-beaten face with a broken nose and healed brow scar, dark knotwork tattoos on the neck and forearms, scuffed spike-toed boots. Intimidating scowl, rugged unglamorized features, patched practical clothing with dirty leather straps, rusted studs and torn hems
fighters.weapon: Bell-rope weight, calls each long swing with a hollow ring

fighters.name: Noll Knucklebent
fighters.look: Sturdy man in his 50s, grey eyebrows, reinforced purple coat, spare knuckle plates on a chain
fighters.weapon: Folding knuckle clubs, two close strikes with a snap-open heavy follow-up

fighters.name: Seth Stillplumb
fighters.look: Athletic man in his 30s, deep brown skin, violet apron, silver plumb bobs decorating the hem
fighters.weapon: Tethered plumb weight, shifts between a hanging block and a rising attack

fighters.name: Ivo OfftheLatch
fighters.look: Long-armed man in his 40s, pale shaved head, orange shoulder pad, blue mechanic’s sleeves
fighters.weapon: Latch-shaped axe and forearm guard, uses quick hook feints to create room for wide chops

fighters.name: Tressa Torsion
fighters.look: Powerful woman in her 40s. Ragged short mohawk, a heavy jaw and crooked nose with a healed cheek scar, bold geometric neck tattoos, a battered spike-topped iron helmet. Intimidating scowl, rugged unglamorized features, patched practical clothing with dirty leather straps, rusted studs and torn hems
fighters.weapon: Spring-loaded staff, coils visibly before a quick extended strike

fighters.name: Nev ReverseSwing
fighters.look: Tall man in his 50s, silver curls, dark skin, black coat that fastens at either shoulder
fighters.weapon: Double-hinged poleaxe, changes the angle of its second sweep and braces after a block

fighters.name: Foreman Halfturn
fighters.look: Broad man in his 60s, salt-and-pepper beard, plum coat, iron-braced leg, giant ceremonial key
fighters.weapon: Key-shaped warhammer and hinge shield, pivots around the shield before a punishing return swing

arenas.name: Noonless Quay
arenas.summary: Customs officers, dockside brokers, and shippers whose cargo includes shadows, clocks, and other nuisances.

fighters.name: Giles Halfshadow
fighters.look: Slim man in his 20s, dark skin, lavender scarf, one matte-black glove
fighters.weapon: Shadow-black sap, darting body taps and a quick step back

fighters.name: Parn Declaredgoods
fighters.look: Stout man in his 30s, trimmed brown beard, white cuff bands, indigo inspector’s vest
fighters.weapon: Cargo chalk baton, marks the ground before a deliberate strike

fighters.name: Tavi LooseManifest
fighters.look: Tall man in his 30s, grey-dyed coils, olive spectacles, coat hung with torn tags
fighters.weapon: Manifest rod and leather folio shield, counters with a fast tap when the folio catches a swing

fighters.name: Hal NoRefunds
fighters.look: Broad man in his 40s, brown skin, red wax seals across his cuffs, charcoal leather apron
fighters.weapon: Tollbox hammer, announces a heavy hit with the loose coins rattling inside

fighters.name: Wolfrin Longqueue
fighters.look: Lanky man in his 50s, sunken cheeks, purple scarf, straight grey hair, brass queue token
fighters.weapon: Queue-barrier pole, blocks advance and punishes attempts to pass on either side

fighters.name: Adra Nightreceipt
fighters.look: Athletic woman in her 30s. Close buzz cut, a craggy face with a split eyebrow and old chin scar, black thorn tattoos on the arms, removable steel fangs fitted over the teeth. Intimidating scowl, rugged unglamorized features, patched practical clothing with dirty leather straps, rusted studs and torn hems
fighters.weapon: Split quill daggers, rapid paired strikes after a precise retreating step

fighters.name: Tavros Dockminute
fighters.look: Heavyset man in his 40s, dark skin, grey braided beard, oversized stopped watch pinned to the chest
fighters.weapon: Pendulum axe, timed diagonal sweeps with the last one landing off the beat

fighters.name: Ves LockofFog
fighters.look: Tall man in his 40s, translucent grey hood, silver eyebrows, knotwork on dark gloves
fighters.weapon: Fog lantern flail and smoked-glass guard, obscures the recovery before changing swing direction

fighters.name: Bria BondedCargo
fighters.look: Muscular woman in her 50s, warm brown skin. Hard undercut with a short bristling crest, an angular weathered face and healed lip scar, dense band tattoos around the neck, clawed steel gauntlets. Intimidating scowl, rugged unglamorized features, patched practical clothing with dirty leather straps, rusted studs and torn hems
fighters.weapon: Cargo chain and hook shield, alternates heavy swings at distance with guarded pressure up close

fighters.name: Magistrate Missing Noon
fighters.look: Stately man in his 60s, high white collar, violet undershirt, ink-dark steel, unlit clock crown
fighters.weapon: Long customs seal halberd, patient blocks followed by accelerating strikes when the opponent presses
